corrections.interpretation: OnAnyMoveStarted compares waterColorId with _colorId. It loads __this._belongingBottle and calls HasOverlayBlocker on that HOST bottle. Only when the HOST has no overlay does state decrement. It does not test targetBottle overlay in this branch.

Both IsSelectableAsOrigin and IsSelectableAsTarget return _state < _belongingBottle.GetFillAmount(). The target method receives waterColorId but does not use it. Color gates state decrease in OnAnyMoveStarted, not these selection predicates.
